name: Kohima
description: Capital of Nagaland and headquarters of Kohima district, a scenic hill town at about 1,444 m elevation known for its Angami Naga culture, War Cemetery, and as the base for Hornbill Festival and surrounding highland attractions.
facts: Gateway to Dzukou Valley and Kisama
Host base for annual Hornbill Festival

name: Kachari Ruins (Ruins of Kachari Rajbari)
description: Medieval ruins of the Dimasa Kachari kingdom capital in Dimapur, featuring distinctive mushroom-domed sandstone pillars and carved monoliths dating to the 10th–13th centuries. ASI-protected site with intricate motifs; remnants of the ancient fortified capital.
facts: Mushroom-domed pillars up to 15 ft high
Ancient capital of Dimasa Kachari kingdom
Located near Naga Shopping Arcade / Circuit House

name: Dimapur
description: Largest city and commercial gateway of Nagaland on the banks of the Dhansiri River. Main air and rail entry point; historic Kachari area with multi-ethnic markets and base for highland circuits.
facts: Largest city and main gateway of Nagaland

name: Nagaland Science Centre
description: Interactive science museum in Dimapur with galleries, science park and Taramandal planetarium. Educational family attraction promoting scientific awareness.
facts: Located at Super Market Lane, Half Nagarjan

name: Green Park
description: Recreational park at 4th Mile inside the State Horticulture Nursery, Dimapur. Greenery, boating, picnic areas and adventure activities for families.

name: Dimapur Jain Temple
description: Historic Digambara Jain temple to Lord Mahavira established in 1947. Important spiritual landmark with intricate glasswork for the local Jain community.
facts: Managed by SD Jain Samaj Dimapur
Additional shrines to Adinath and Bahubali

name: NEZCC Stone Garden and North East Heritage Museum
description: Cultural complex near Dimapur Airport with stone sculpture garden, traditional morungs and museum of northeastern crafts and artefacts.
facts: Near airport, ~3 km from railway station

name: Dhansiri River (Dimapur Section)
description: River flowing along Dimapur giving the city its historic name. Scenic banks for walks and local recreation in the plains.

name: Hong Kong Market
description: Bustling commercial market in central Dimapur selling imported goods, clothing, electronics and local products. Vibrant trading hub.

name: Dimapur City Tower (Clock Tower)
description: Landmark clock tower on Circular Road in central Dimapur. Popular photo spot, often lit during festivals.
